title_it: Jonas, Café Berlin (tedesco): Marea 2 Plus, caffè slavato + guarnizione + scheda
title_en: Jonas, Café Berlin (German): Marea 2 Plus, weak coffee + gasket + board

lines.text: Hello, good morning. This is Jonas, from Cafe Berlin, in Hamburg.
lines.cue: Good morning, Sereni service, Michael speaking. How can I help you?

lines.text: We have a problem with our coffee machine. It is the Marea 2 Plus, the vanilla one, the cream colour.
lines.cue: Hello Jonas. Which machine is it, and what is the problem?
lines.expect_it: Macchina: Marea 2 Plus, edizione Vaniglia. Nessun sintomo ancora.

lines.text: Since maybe two weeks, the coffee comes out very thin and fast. Like water. No body, no crema.
lines.cue: Okay. What is the coffee doing?
lines.expect_it: Apre il fascicolo «Caffè slavato», passo 1 (tempo di erogazione).

lines.text: A double shot takes maybe fifteen, eighteen seconds. Before it was longer.
lines.cue: How long does a double shot take, from the button to the end?
lines.expect_it: Tu scegli «Meno di 20 secondi» → passo macinatura.

lines.text: The last cleaning with the tablet and the blind filter... honestly, I think two or three weeks ago.
lines.cue: Tighten the grinder by two notches, 14 grams in the double basket, and pull another shot. Meanwhile: when did you last backflush with the tablet?

lines.text: Okay, I did the backflush now, five times with the tablet. It is still weak.
lines.cue: Please backflush with a tablet: five cycles of ten seconds, then five rinses. Then try again.

lines.text: I unscrewed the shower screen. It has white scale on it, but the holes are fine, not damaged.
lines.cue: Unscrew the shower screen, the screw in the middle of the group, and hold it up to the light. Is it damaged?

lines.text: I put it in the descaler and cleaned it. Now the coffee is much better, yes. Thank you.
lines.cue: Put it in the descaler for twenty minutes, brush, rinse, refit it with the convex side down, and pull a shot.
lines.expect_it: Clicca «Risolto da remoto». Il sintomo si chiude.

lines.text: Also, when I lock the portafilter it goes very far to the right, and water comes around. Last year we ordered the gasket, the code on the invoice is G E twenty-one forty.
lines.expect_it: Nuovo sintomo «Perdita dal gruppo» + scheda GE-2140 (lo monta il cliente, frase pronta).

lines.text: The serial number is zero four seven, two one nine.
lines.cue: I have the gasket in stock. Do you have the serial number of the machine?
lines.expect_it: Scheda macchina 047219: Café Berlin, Vaniglia, in garanzia fino a maggio 2027, ordini precedenti.

lines.text: One more thing. The control board, on the old one is written E L three zero one zero. Is it still the same part?
lines.cue: Under warranty, so no charge. I ship it from Rotterdam, one or two days, you can fit it yourself.
lines.expect_it: EL-3010 sostituito da EL-3012 (con il service); niente adattatore: macchina 2025.

lines.text: Okay, perfect. Please send the gasket and the tablets to Hamburg. Thank you, goodbye.
lines.cue: EL-3010 was replaced by EL-3012. That one needs our service to fit it; we book a second call when it arrives.
lines.expect_it: Scheda pastiglie CR-6052 dalla descrizione. Poi «Chiudi chiamata» → resoconto.
